arguments.text: Goal: fastest 10 km. Pace evenly on pod power near sustainable_shaft_power (about 150-155 W; pre-race CP pod 149 W, reserve 17 kJ, could be 10-25% off). Keep pod reserve above ~30% until 2.5 km to go, then spend it; finish cue about 1000-1200 m to go. Check CP with heart rate: at steady pod power HR levels off below CP, keeps climbing above it. Incidents: speed falls at the same pod power and HR in both directions = extra drag (weed: clear_rudder); pod power changes with speed and HR flat = pod drift (set pod_gain); radio messages may change the course (set_race_distance, tell). Use pieces/measure only when the answer changes the plan. Save cues (20 max).
